title: World from Motion: Generative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Video
abstract: arXiv:2607.01202v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present World from Motion, a method for generating freely renderable dynamic 3D Gaussian representations from monocular videos. Our approach conditions a video model on dense, pixel-aligned renderings that encode appearance, geometry, and 3D scene motion along both input and target camera trajectories to correct rendering artifacts and fill in missing regions from an initial reconstruction. To train this model, we construct a dataset of aligned multiview video pairs and dynamic 3DGS representations, with simulated artifacts characteristic of monocular reconstruction. At test time, we distill the model's generations, including newly observed regions and motions, back into a single consistent, high-quality dynamic 3DGS, improving both novel-view synthesis and the underlying 3D motion. Our method sets a new state of the art in 4D reconstruction and seamlessly generalizes to in-the-wild videos with large viewpoint changes and dy

translated_title: 从运动中生成世界：基于单目视频的生成式动态高斯重建
translated_abstract: 我们提出了 World from Motion，一种从单目视频生成可自由渲染的动态 3D 高斯表示的方法。我们的方法以密集的、像素对齐的渲染结果为条件驱动视频模型，这些渲染编码了外观、几何信息以及沿输入与目标相机轨迹的 3D 场景运动，用于纠正渲染伪影并填补初始重建中缺失的区域。为训练该模型，我们构建了一个由对齐的多视角视频对和动态 3DGS 表示组成的数据集，其中模拟了单目重建特有的伪影。在测试阶段，我们将模型的生成结果（包括新观测到的区域和运动）蒸馏回单个一致且高质量的动态 3DGS 中，从而同时提升新视角合成质量和底层 3D 运动的准确性。我们的方法在 4D 重建领域创造了新的最先进水平，并能无缝泛化到具有大视角变化和动态场景的真实世界视频中。
tldr: 提出 World from Motion 方法，利用视频生成模型修正并补全单目视频的动态 3D 高斯重建，将生成结果蒸馏回统一的高质量动态 3DGS，在 4D 重建与新视角合成上达到新的最先进水平。
en_tdlr: World from Motion leverages a generative video model conditioned on pixel-aligned renderings to correct artifacts and complete missing regions in monocular dynamic 3D Gaussian reconstruction, distilling generations into a single consistent dynamic 3DGS that sets a new state of the art in 4D reconstruction and novel-view synthesis.
